name: sensei_pure_determine_level
description: Pure function determine_level returns correct level for all 4 thresholds
input:
pure determine_level
  needs score: Number
  gives Text
  do
    if score >= 90
      give "expert"
    if score >= 70
      give "journeyman"
    if score >= 40
      give "apprentice"
    give "novice"

fn main
  say determine_level(95)
  say determine_level(75)
  say determine_level(50)
  say determine_level(20)
